sections.hypothesis: Holding the three coins with the best average rank on 30, 60 and 90-day returns, among liquid coins, each only while its own 90-day return is positive, beats the large-basket control and BTC at the same exposure on Sharpe, after costs.
sections.rationale: Who pays: cross-sectional momentum in crypto (Liu, Tsyvinski and Wu 2022, Common Risk Factors in Cryptocurrency, Journal of Finance) is one of the strongest documented crypto factors; the 9,000-backtest video (Luke's YouTube batch 2) found cross-sectional momentum scored far better than single-asset momentum. Honest overlap: Kestrel's cross-sectional momentum top 5 (7/14/28-day ranks, weekly) was dropped after a -92% drawdown and a Sharpe of 0.69 vs 1.07 for BTC; the published factor is long-short, and long-only keeps the half that crashed. This version changes the horizon to the published 1-3 months and holds three coins (the account's limit) instead of five. It is a variant of a dropped strategy: freezing it is Luke's knowing override of the entry bar, and its runs count as trials.
sections.rules: The existing xs-momentum strategy (kestrel.strategies.momentum) on the coin universe, daily bars, decided each Sunday close: eligible coins have 180 days of unbroken history and a 30-day median quote volume of at least 20M USDT; rank by the average of their 30, 60 and 90-day return ranks; hold the top 3 at a third each; a held coin whose own 90-day return isn't positive leaves its slot in cash. Delisted coins included. Costs from kestrel.toml with each coin's own spread band, 330 USDT (three 110 USDT slots). Period 2020-01 to 2025-10, before the holdout; tokenized stocks don't appear before 2026-06, so they can't enter it.
sections.falsification: Against the large-basket control and BTC at the same exposure, with the full scorecard. Fails on any failed test; the drawdown limit (50%) is the likely one, as it was for top 5.
sections.parameters: top_n 3, fast_days 30, mid_days 60, slow_days 90, min_history_days 180, min_volume_musd 20. One run. The robustness check moves each (about 20 neighbours).
sections.costs: Weekly decisions with 1-3 month ranks change slowly: perhaps 30-60 coin swaps a year at 22-40 bps each (smaller coins pay wider spreads), 1-2% a year in costs. Trials: 1 run plus about 20 neighbours.
